description_en: Retrieves the execution status of all code blocks in a Spark session
description_zh: 获取Spark Session的所有代码块的执行状态
name: ListSparkStatements

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Spark job
parameters.name: job_id

Statements.description_en: The list of code block execution results
Statements.description_zh: 代码块执行结果的列表

Code.description_en: The code block submitted for execution

CompletedTime.description_en: The timestamp in milliseconds when the execution is completed
CompletedTime.description_zh: 执行完成的毫秒级时间戳

Id.description_en: The unique ID of the code block

Output.description_en:
The execution result of the code block. The execution result is a JSON-formatted string with the following structure:

status: The execution status.
execution_count: The line number of the code block that is currently being executed.
data: The code execution result
Output.description_zh:
代码块的执行结果，执行结果是一个JSON格式的字符串，其结构如下。

status：执行状态。
execution_count：当前执行到此代码块的哪一行。
data：代码执行结果

Progress.description_en: The current execution progress. This is a floating-point number that represents the execution percentage. A value of 1 indicates 100% completion
Progress.description_zh: 当前执行进度，是一个浮点数，代表执行的百分比，‘1’代表100%执行完成

StartedTime.description_en: The timestamp in milliseconds when the code block starts to be executed
StartedTime.description_zh: 代码块开始执行的毫秒级时间戳

State.description_en:
The execution status of the code block. Valid values:

waiting: Waiting for execution.
running: Being executed.
available: Execution completed.
error: Execution failed.
cancelling: Attempting to stop.
cancelled: Execution stopped
State.description_zh:
代码块的执行状态，可能的状态有：

waiting：等待执行。
running：正在执行。
available：执行完成。
error：执行失败。
cancelling：尝试终止。
cancelled：已经终止执行
